I stopped round 489 before hand-over. My code-reviewer found a Medium problem in the tests that the task doesn't rule on, and the task forbids changing any sketch line, so B needs to rule on it. The sketch itself applied cleanly and all the checks I was asked to run passed. The full report is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-489.md`.

**STOP: A-R489-REVIEW-NONZOOM-CLASSIFY (Medium, found by my code-reviewer)**
- The tests send the "normal scroll" gesture as a plain `Event`, not as a real wheel or touch event (`store-entrance-loader.test.tsx:62-64`). So they never check that an ordinary wheel or one-finger swipe is told apart from a zoom gesture.
- I confirmed it on a scratch copy, not in `store/`. Four deliberately broken versions of that check all still pass 61/61: any wheel counted as zoom, or one finger counted as a pinch, in both the React overlay and the boot script. Two of B's known-bad versions (M20, M18) correctly fail in the same copy. Log: `a-round-489/review-mutants.log`.
- The real-browser row C8 would catch the wheel cases. Nothing automated catches the one-finger touch cases; only the real-phone manual check would.
- Suggested fix for B (not applied): send a real `WheelEvent` and a one-touch `TouchEvent` in those tests, and add the four broken versions to the mutant script.

**K17 claim mismatch (environment, not a STOP)**
- The start check matched B's planning output on every line except K17. B's two `.webm` recordings in `b-round-488/probe/rec/` are missing, because `*.webm` is gitignored and wasn't restored on the fresh machine.
- C's claims check allows only K16 to differ, so C will hit the same K17 mismatch. B or root needs to rule on it.
- The sketch patch sha256 matches (`4a15bff3…`), and doc 316 doesn't cite the recordings.

**What I ran**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `git apply` of the sketch | rc 0 |
| K14 (tree equals B's sketch) | `====`, also after all tools ran |
| Changed paths | exactly 3 modified + 1 new (doc 316); `root.tsx` unchanged |
| `npm run typecheck` | rc 0 |
| `npm run lint` | rc 0 |
| Biome on the owned paths | rc 0, only the 3 known warnings |
| vitest on the 4 covering files | 4 files / 92 tests passed, no slow test |

**Code review:** a real code-reviewer agent reviewed all 4 files: no Critical or High, one Medium (the STOP above), three Lows, all logged for B and none changed by me.
- The test asserts on a styling class (`pointer-events-none`).
- Doc 316's status line already says `Completed (C round 489 PASS)`, which the loop's L28 rule requires.
- One test hardcodes 250 instead of using `ENTRANCE_EXIT_MS`.
- **Architecture note:** the zoom check exists twice, once in the boot script and once in `isZoomGesture`. The reviewer proposes either generating one from the other or adding a test that runs the same events through both. It's in the report for B and root.

I read doc 316 in full and found no false line.

**Not done:** no browser run, build, full suite or B's mutant run (the task doesn't ask A for these), so nothing is real-verified. The tree is left exactly at the sketch-applied state. Nothing was committed, and I'm not marking any backlog item done.
